categories.main_business_segments: Guangzhou Lingwe Technology Co., Ltd. primarily focuses on the research, development, production, and sales of nano silica new materials. Its main product lines include matting agents, adsorbents, anti-rust pigments, and opening agents. The company also engages in sales of coating additives and other materials, serving industries such as coatings, inks, 3C electronics, photovoltaics, plastics, petrochemicals, and medical films.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes proprietary low-temperature concurrent flow methods and advanced surface treatment technologies for nano silica production, enhancing product uniformity and performance. It also employs precipitation and gel methods for synthesizing nano silica and nano alumina, with digital, automated, and information-based production processes at its Ma'anshan base. The company holds 12 core technologies and 32 patents, focusing on high-end nano silica applications and environmentally friendly ion-exchange anti-rust pigments.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Lingwe Technology serves a broad range of customers in industrial manufacturing, wood products, furniture, leather, textiles, printing materials, advertising supplies, rail transit, 3C electronics, photovoltaics, petrochemicals, and plastic films. Its products are used in coatings, inks, plastics, medical gloves, battery separators, solar cell backsheet films, and emerging fields like fire-resistant materials and precision substrate polishing. The company has established stable partnerships with over 3,000 enterprises globally, including major international coating, ink, and plastic customers.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with production bases in Guangzhou, Ma'anshan (Anhui), Hunan, Shanghai, and other locations. It has expanded its sales network across major Chinese regions including North China, East China, Central China, South China, and Southwest China. Internationally, Lingwe exports products to Southeast Asia, Europe, and other countries, with a growing overseas sales proportion accounting for 24.42% of revenue in 2024.
categories.supply_chain_position: Lingwe Technology operates mainly in the midstream segment of the supply chain, focusing on the manufacturing and development of nano silica and related nano materials. It sources raw materials like sodium silicate, concentrated sulfuric acid, and silica gel, and supplies high-value-added nano materials to downstream industries such as coatings, plastics, and electronics.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes R&D investment to enhance product performance and expand into high-end nano silica applications. Key R&D projects include UV wood floor nano silica, heavy-duty anti-rust pigments for engineering machinery, pharmaceutical excipient nano silica, medical film nano alumina, and optical film opening agents. Lingwe emphasizes sustainable development, digital intelligent manufacturing, and continuous innovation to strengthen its competitive edge and broaden product applications in new energy, biomedicine, and environmental protection sectors.
categories.revenue_model: Lingwe Technology generates revenue primarily through product sales of nano silica and related nano materials. Sales are conducted mainly via direct sales to end customers, supplemented by distributors and traders. Revenue recognition follows delivery and customer acceptance, with export sales recognized upon customs clearance or carrier receipt. The company also earns investment income from financial products but this is non-recurring.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Lingwe Technology is a leading domestic player in the nano silica industry, especially in matting agents and adsorbents, breaking long-standing foreign monopolies. It is recognized as a top supplier in the Chinese coatings industry and leads in drafting national industry standards. While still smaller than international chemical giants, Lingwe is rapidly expanding its product range, application fields, and market share, leveraging strong R&D and customer responsiveness to maintain a competitive position.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Lingwe Technology reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 479 million, a 2.79% increase from 2023, with net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 134.9 million, up 8.02%. The company’s total assets reached RMB 1.76 billion, growing 4.37% year-over-year. Nano new materials accounted for over 97% of revenue, growing 13.32%. The company is in a rapid growth phase, expanding production capacity and improving profitability.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Lingwe Technology emphasizes high-quality, stable-performance nano silica products with excellent cost-effectiveness, tailored to meet diverse customer needs across multiple industries. Its proprietary technologies enable superior product uniformity, transparency, and environmental friendliness, such as ion-exchange anti-rust pigments and high-purity opening agents. The company’s strong R&D capabilities, rapid customer response, and extensive application coverage differentiate it from competitors and support domestic substitution of imported high-end nano materials.
